issues.problem: Microsoft's fiscal 2024 operating income was about $109.4 billion, not $88.5 billion. $88.5 billion is close to net income ($88.1 billion), so the two may have been confused. The text's own note to record operating income as $109.4 billion gives the correct figure and contradicts the $88.5 billion stated in the analysis.

data.summary: Revenue ($245.1B, up 15.7% from $211.9B), net income ($88.1B), total assets ($512.2B) and cash and cash equivalents ($18.3B) all match Microsoft's FY2024 results. The operating income figure is wrong: the correct number is about $109.4B, not $88.5B.
